warnings: The source itself cannot establish that M. canis alone caused the polymicrobial skin syndrome or prove dog-to-human transmission; the SEA preserves these as evidence boundaries.
The source uses borrowed Staphylococcus/EUCAST breakpoints and explicitly lacks breakpoints for mupirocin, tiamulin, and streptomycin; the SEA appropriately foregrounds this uncertainty.
